source: Founder instruction 2026-10-24: Modern Technical DNA and Modern Strategic Pillars

dimensions.application: Concurrent-in-one-pass defender/critic/counterexample analysis with measurable acceptance tests
Authorized asset dependency DAG, concentration and evidence-bound risk scenarios
Least privilege, key custody, threat modeling and recovery, without claims of impossible compromise
Verify continuously, segment authority, audit access, plan incident response
Lawful data minimization and identity separation with residual re-identification risk
Regulated location-aware redundancy, not tax/KYC evasion
Recovery objectives, alternative paths, tested restore and offline fallback
Evidence-calibrated aggregate scenarios with uncertainty, privacy and human oversight

mandatory: Opus strategic outputs include plausible alternative, attempted falsification, measured risk, and evidence gaps. No full specialist swarm by default.
preserveFounderClaims: global anchors without single point failures
corrections: security is not mathematically absolute for systems and compromised endpoints
cross-border distribution does not cancel law or reporting
human behavior cannot be predicted with mathematical certainty
